completed_work.summary: Stage 1 architecture phase. Read the entire legacy codebase. Moved every pre-existing file into _legacy/ preserving internal structure (nothing deleted). (1) Four JSON Schemas at schemas/: job_status.schema.json, stage_a_request.schema.json, production_plan.schema.json, analysis_bundle.schema.json — all four validated as well-formed Draft 2020-12. Both accept the ARCHITECTURE.md nested `series` object AND the legacy flat `series_*` siblings, and both accept `voiceover_text` OR legacy `raw_narration`. (4) pipeline/status.py — atomic status.json writer + ten-state state machine (ARCHITECTURE.md §6). Refuses to leave terminal states (complete/error/cancelled) except into another terminal state. CLI entry point for GitHub Actions. (5) bot/src/jobs.js — pure JS state-machine helpers (newStatus / mergeStatus / canTransition / serializeStatus / statusPath) that share constants with the Python side. (6) Tests: pipeline/tests/test_status.py (13 cases), pipeline/tests/test_plan_cross_validation.py (2 cases including the JS/Python equivalence check driven by a 26-document language-neutral fixture at pipeline/tests/fixtures/plan_cases.json via a Node shim at pipeline/tests/run_js_validator.mjs), bot/test/plan.test.mjs + bot/test/jobs.test.mjs (15 JS cases). completed_work.summary: Built the stage_b_render phase in full. New package pipeline/stage_b/: (1) common.py — ffmpeg/ffprobe wrappers, StageBError, load_production_plan() which RE-VALIDATES production.json at the Stage B boundary via the single-source validator (ARCHITECTURE.md §13 invariant #5) and normalizes both accepted shapes (nested series object OR flat series_* siblings; voiceover_text OR legacy raw_narration) exactly as pipeline/plan/schema.py does; branding readers (tts_settings, creator_watermark, music_default) and job-id sanitizer. (2) voiceover.py — Edge TTS synthesis with the curated 12-voice catalog, 24kHz mono PCM WAV contract, two-pass EBU R128 speech-clarity mastering, retry/backoff. (3) render.py — timing reconciliation (per-cut setpts retime, boundaries never move, no stretch ceiling, duration-collapse guard), single-pass mobile-safe merge (H.264 High@L4.0 / yuv420p / 30fps CFR / AAC-LC 48kHz / faststart / mp42 / no B-frames / no edit lists), optional ducked music bed, merged voiceover WAV + cut_timing.json sidecar, and strict output validation. (4) reframe.py — ffmpeg scene detection, per-scene static 1080x1200 crop windows, optional CPU InsightFace prominent-face focus with safe centre fallback. (5) captions.py — faster-whisper word timing (timing only), authoritative script alignment, sentence cards (<=6 words, clause breaks), author keyword #RRGGBB colors, Pillow 3-layer raster (soft shadow + keyline + fills), one-time Coolvetica title banner with eased drop-in/hold/drop-out, fail-closed caption-timeline validation, ASS debug sidecar. (6) watermark.py — screen-blend creator watermark with letter-shaped Gaussian shadow; empty name is an explicit no-op. (7) enhance.py — hqdn3d -> Hald-LUT color cube -> cas -> thresholded unsharp -> gradfun chain with mobile-safe re-validation and atomic in-place swap; --no-enabled is a true no-op. (8) compress.py — terminal CRF-23 delivery pass preserving video invariants, audio stream-copied, never ships a larger file. (9) run.py — orchestrator that writes jobs/<job_id>/status.json via pipeline.status before/after each risky step, plus metadata.txt and final.zip packaging (§7.4). Also added pipeline/requirements.txt, copied required assets (assets/fonts/Coolvetica.ttf, assets/anime_reference_lut_grid.png, assets/anime_reference_color_cube_l8.png) from _legacy, wrote .github/workflows/stage-b.yml (dispatchable by job_id + production_ref; path/asset/url ref resolution; source asset download accepting both the new source_input.bin and legacy original.* names; series cross-check against stage-a-request.json; restart-correct code_ref checkout + HEAD re-attach; terminal-state archiving on restart; rebase-and-retry status pushes; dedicated stage_b_cancelled job; final.mp4 + final.zip + metadata.txt uploaded to the job release; complete/error status persisted with asset URLs). Tests: 33 new unit tests in pipeline/tests/test_stage_b.py (56 Python total, all pass) and pipeline/tests/smoke_stage_b_local.py, a real-ffmpeg end-to-end smoke run of the whole chain on synthetic media (Edge TTS and Whisper stubbed — no network/model downloads in the build environment) that produced and validated a mobile-safe 1080x1200 final MP4. All 15 existing bot JS tests still pass.

architecture_concerns.decision_at_stake: ARCHITECTURE.md §7.3 documents production.json's series data as a NESTED object (`series.series_id`, `series.part`, `series.start_seconds`, `series.end_seconds`, `series.is_final`, `series.summary`). The legacy contract (_legacy/schemas/production_plan_contract.json and _legacy/scripts/production_plan_contract.py) uses FLAT sibling fields (`series_id`, `series_part`, `series_start_seconds`, `series_end_seconds`, `series_final`, `series_summary`). ARCHITECTURE.md §14 also states 'the production.json field names and validation semantics' are intentionally NOT changing — which is in tension with the nested rewrite in §7.3. Existing legacy plans, and the legacy manual browser tool that users still paste output from, all use the flat shape.
architecture_concerns.why_i_think_this_needs_attention: Two producers (external agents pasted by the user in Manual mode, and any tool referencing the old browser validator) will keep emitting the flat shape. If Stage B were coded to accept only the nested shape it would reject every legacy plan on sight; if the flat shape were coded to be the only accepted shape, we would drift from ARCHITECTURE.md §7.3. Only the operator can decide which is canonical.
architecture_concerns.what_i_did_for_now: Applied the closest-analog policy: accepted BOTH shapes in schema.py and plan.js (nested wins per-field when both are present), mirroring the already-established precedent of accepting `raw_narration` alongside `voiceover_text`. Continued to build against ARCHITECTURE.md as written — the nested shape is preferred and documented as such. This does not silently redesign anything: both shapes validate to identical semantics.
architecture_concerns.what_the_right_answer_probably_is: Pick one. If Stage B ports cleanly from the legacy scripts (which read `series_id`, `series_part`, …), the FLAT shape is the pragmatic canonical and ARCHITECTURE.md §7.3 should be revised to match. If the nested shape is genuinely preferred, add a note in §7.3 that legacy flat form is accepted for input but is deprecated on output — and update 00_READ_THIS_FIRST.txt (the analysis prompt) so external agents emit the nested shape.
architecture_concerns.action_requested: Operator: pick a canonical shape and update ARCHITECTURE.md §7.3 / §14 accordingly. Until then future sessions should keep accepting both — do NOT delete either code path in schema.py or plan.js without operator sign-off.
